sn9.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam aññataro bhikkhu Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || 2.
sn9.11:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu divāvihāragato pāpake akusale vitakke vitakketi || seyyathīdaṃ
sn9.11:1.4: Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā tam bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetukāmā yena so bhikkhu ten-upasaṅkami || || 4. Upasaṅkamitvā tam bhikkhuṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.11:4.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegam āpādīti || || 1.
